svg.aria-label: On the left, a PR titled fix stuff, crossed out: the reviewer has to reverse-engineer it. On the right, a PR description drawn as a document with five sections: problem, what the user sees; root cause, why it happens; decisions, what was chosen and rejected; evidence, logs and before and after; tests, what ran and what it proves. A note: one sitting, no investigation, no round trips.
svg.text: A PR A STRANGER COULD APPROVE
the description is the deliverable. the diff is the evidence
what the user sees, the ticket
why it happens, with the line
what I chose, what I rejected
